verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a REST interface, a CLI and generated SDKs, but nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path. The server-page "try" feature is about MCP servers in the registry, not about exploring Smithery's own API reference, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
